intro: Outside Northshire Abbey, Willem sends recruits to meet the valley's threats. He serves under Marshal McBride in the Stormwind Army, with the Defias Brotherhood pressing into Northshire.

p: Deputy Willem watches the gates of Northshire Abbey, where the Stormwind Army keeps a foothold in the valley. The kingdom's soldiers are spread across many territories, leaving local defense to small groups like Marshal McBride's garrison. Willem meets incoming volunteers and sends them to aid residents and guard the valley's edges.

The Defias Brotherhood is Willem's most pressing concern. Red-bandana bandits have entered Northshire, stolen supplies, threatened farmer Milly Osworth, and taken footholds among nearby vineyards and hills. Willem offers bounties on known cutthroats such as Garrick Padfoot, hoping to break their leadership before they can take the abbey grounds.
